name.description: Name of the publication, such as Reuters.

direct.description: True when Context observed this article in the publisher-owned feed.

source.description: The publication that published the article.

level.description: primary when the article is mainly about the company, secondary when the company is mentioned but is not the main subject.

confidence.description: How confident the match is, from 0 to 1. Null when a score is unavailable.

match.description: How the article relates to the company you searched for. Null for natural-language searches.

data.description: Articles matching the search, in the requested order.
